method: Read original case_text for an individual human clinical narrative, blinded to external model predictions; flag cohort, review, veterinary and multipatient source units.

exclusions.reason: Predominantly general COVID-19 background; the only patient-specific content is a single closing sentence, insufficient as a full clinical case narrative.
Comparative MIS-C cohort statistics with no single index-patient narrative; one brief individual anecdote does not define the whole document.
Aggregate pathological and clinical summary of four patients; the source does not identify one index patient for this narrative.
Literature overview of several other authors' case reports, not an original individual case narrative.
Combined treatment-program narrative of two separate participants, incompatible with one patient per document.
Veterinary case describing a Great Dane dog, outside the human clinical study population.
Combined report of two unrelated family probands, incompatible with one patient per document.
Aggregate prevalence comparison among people experiencing homelessness and shelter workers, without an index patient.
Eight-patient case series reported collectively, with no single index-patient narrative.
Multicenter retrospective series of six patients rather than a single index-patient narrative.
Veterinary report of a chinchilla, outside the human clinical study population.
